description: Get nature details — the stat boosted (+10%), stat reduced (-10%), and preferred/disliked berry flavors. Omit the identifier to list all 25 natures at once. Natures are critical for competitive team-building: every non-neutral nature modifies two stats by ±10%.

identifier.description: Nature name (e.g. "modest", "jolly") or ID 1–25 as a string. Omit to list all 25 natures.

name: pokeapi_get_nature

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The identifier resolves to no nature in PokéAPI. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

isListAll.description: True when all 25 natures are returned (no identifier provided).

natures.description: One or all 25 natures depending on whether identifier was provided.

items.description: Nature entry with stat modifiers and flavor preferences.

decreasedStat.description: Stat reduced by 10%. Null for neutral natures.

hatesFlavor.description: Berry flavor the Pokémon dislikes. Null for neutral natures.

increasedStat.description: Stat boosted by 10%. Null for neutral natures.

likesFlavor.description: Berry flavor the Pokémon prefers. Null for neutral natures.

title: Get Nature
